# Trading Direkt 2026-11-03 | Niklas Wellfelt, aktie- och allokeringsstrateg, Tobbe med TA

**Feed**: trading-direkt  
**Published**: 2026-11-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Niklas Wellfelt, the guest strategist from Ålandsbanken, is constructive. He expects the economy to strengthen and company earnings to keep rising, and he sees valuations as roughly neutral. He favours equities (about 70% in stocks and 30% in fixed income, weighted to corporate bonds), especially industrials, banks and healthcare such as AstraZeneca, and expects small caps to pick up in 2027. The main risks he names are AI capex financing, oil at about $106 with Hormuz closed, and the US midterm election. Host Tobbe Rosén's technical analysis is mixed: November seasonality is positive, but a rising VIX and a possibly broken rising wedge on OMXS30 are warning signs. His single-stock views range from very positive (Hexagon) to negative (SBB, Sireno Scientific).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 AZN — AstraZeneca | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest highlights good Q3 report, shares still at lower price/valuation levels, good potential; defensive hedge.

#### Reasoning

Guest strategist recommends healthcare as complement to cyclical tilt over 12 months; AstraZeneca delivered a good report and trades from depressed valuation levels, giving upside plus defensive, non-cyclical insurance in a portfolio tilted to a stronger economy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if valuation re-rates fully without earnings follow-through
- if healthcare earnings momentum weakens

> *"Ta AstraZeneca som kom med en bra rapport förra veckan och fortfarande kommer kursmässigt och värderingsmässigt från lite lägre nivåer. Har god potential."*

---

### 🟢 HEXA-B — Hexagon | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Host TA: positive trend, strong year-end seasonality, positive report reception; near-term resistance may need retests.

#### Reasoning

Tobbe is explicitly 'very, very positive'. Stock is in a positive trend with good report reception and historically strong year-end performance. Overbought stochastic MACD and negative divergence at 2023-level resistance may cause a pullback, but he expects an eventual breakout higher.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price is rejected at resistance and trend breaks
- if negative divergence leads to deeper correction

> *"jag hoppas inte det lät som att jag var negativ till aktien för jag är väldigt väldigt positiv till den"*

---

### 🟢 PLTR — Palantir | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host TA: pullback to Ichimoku cloud support, possible completed ABC correction, low volatility; wants positive candlestick confirmation.

#### Reasoning

After the ATH on 12 Oct, price has fallen to a support area (cloud plus flat standard line) with stochastic MACD near zero. The leg lengths suggest an ABC correction reaching target. Host is positive but wants a continuation formation at support before acting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cloud support breaks
- if no positive continuation formation appears

> *"Så jag är positiv till aktien. Och vill som sagt dock se en positiv fortsättningsformation vid ett stöd eftersom vållan är låg."*

---

### 🟠 AVGO — Broadcom | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Host TA: falling wedge typically breaks upward; selling pressure fading; breakout above resistance/MA50/MA20 would be positive.

#### Reasoning

Falling wedges usually resolve upward, and the decline has lost force, suggesting sellers are exhausting. Host says to follow it closely as price nears the wedge apex; entry depends on trader style (inside the wedge vs on breakout).

#### Sell Triggers

- if wedge breaks downward
- if price fails at falling resistance line

> *"Det känns ju lite grann som att säljarna är på väg att köra slut på bränsle."*

---

### 🟢 AREC — American Resources | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host TA: rising trend, pullback to MA200 with waning negative momentum; seasonality weak into year-end.

#### Reasoning

Price pulled back to MA200 within a rising trend and negative momentum is fading, so buyers look likely to take over. Historically weak seasonality into year-end tempers this; host is only slightly positive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if MA200 breaks
- if seasonal weakness materialises

> *"Jag är dock svagt positiv till aktien."*

---

### 🟠 SMOP — Smart Optics | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host positive on the stock but says timing is bad; wait for the cycle indicator to drop and a continuation formation.

#### Reasoning

Stock fell back from resistance with above-average volatility. Host's rules require the cycle indicator to come down, ideally with a positive mini-divergence, before acting on a continuation formation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if price breaks support while volatility stays high

> *"Jag är positiv till aktien men dålig tajming och deposition här tycker jag."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Host slightly negative; decline slowing in a triangle, positive MACD cross; report tomorrow.

#### Reasoning

The rate of decline has eased and stochastic MACD has crossed positively. A move above zero previously triggered a rally toward MA200, but host remains slightly negative pending confirmation and the report.

#### Sell Triggers

- if triangle breaks downward
- if report disappoints

> *"Så jag är än så länge lite svagt negativ till Novo Nordisk."*

---

### ⛔ SBB-B — SBB | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Host TA: lower highs, at all-time low with no support; bounces only pauses in decline; buyers have weak hands.

#### Reasoning

The structure of successively lower highs is intact and price sits at all-time lows with no support below. The positive divergence in stochastic MACD is the only positive piece. Bounces should be treated as pauses until a lower high is broken and retested.

#### Sell Triggers

- if a lower high is broken and retested successfully (would invalidate avoid)

> *"Sen har vi SBB och det är inte så muntert i den."*

---

### 🟠 000660 — SK Hynix | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Host TA: slightly negative consolidation; choppy while inside the range.

#### Reasoning

Price is contracting within a range; until one boundary breaks, expect choppy moves. Host is slightly negative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if range breaks downward

> *"Sen har vi SK Heinix har vi här och det är ju svagt negativt en konsolidering"*
